name: Discord Chat Extractor
description: Export your Discord chat history (servers, channels, DMs) to TXT, Markdown, HTML, Excel, CSV or JSON.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' https://discord.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://cdn.discordapp.com https://media.discordapp.net https://*.discordapp.net https://*.discordapp.com; media-src 'self' blob: https://cdn.discordapp.com https://media.discordapp.net https://*.discordapp.net; font-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'
